evidence.summary: Exhaustive test of every finite FP16 value (N=63488) through the kernel vs FP64 erf reference: 1458 values exceed the 1e-6 absolute tolerance; max error 1.311e-6 at x=0.5083 (actual 0.5277654 vs target 0.5277641).

rationale: The kernel uses 5-digit truncated coefficients (0.25483, -0.28450, 1.42141, -1.45315, 1.06141) instead of the full-precision ones; the A&S formula's nominal accuracy is ~1.5e-7, so truncation could push some mid-range |x| over 1e-6, especially around x≈1-2 where the error peaks.

scope_evidence.summary: Every output element must satisfy abs(actual[i] - erf(x[i])) <= 1e-6; every finite FP16 value is legal; correctness is one verdict for the implementation.

scope_rationale: The contract requires abs(actual - erf(x)) <= 1e-6 for EVERY finite FP16 value, with zero relative tolerance, across the entire legal domain — a single violating value makes the implementation non-compliant.
statement: The truncated A&S coefficients produce an approximation error exceeding the required 1e-6 absolute tolerance for some finite FP16 input value.
